text: The onboarding process was incredibly confusing. I spent 30 minutes trying to figure out how to set up my first project and eventually gave up. The documentation is outdated and doesn't match the current UI.
Love the AI features! The auto-categorization saves me hours every week. Would be great if it could also suggest action items based on the patterns it finds.
We've been using this for 3 months and still can't get the team to adopt it. The learning curve is too steep for non-technical users. My marketing team just goes back to spreadsheets.

Reporting is broken. Exported PDFs have wrong dates, charts don't render properly, and the custom date range picker resets every time I switch tabs. Very frustrating when preparing for board meetings.
The mobile app is fantastic for quick checks on the go. Push notifications for urgent feedback are exactly what I needed. Only wish: let me respond to customers directly from the app.
Pricing is absurd for small businesses. We have 50 feedback items per month and pay the same as enterprises with 50,000. There should be a startup tier.
Integration with Slack is a game changer. Now our whole team sees customer feedback in real-time without logging into another tool. The sentiment alerts are perfect.

I need multilingual support desperately. 40% of our customers write in German or French and the tool can't handle it. Translations are inaccurate and sentiment analysis fails completely for non-English text.
Das Tool ist gut aber die deutsche Übersetzung der Oberfläche ist schlecht. Viele Fachbegriffe sind falsch übersetzt und manche Buttons haben abgeschnittenen Text.
API documentation is excellent. We built a custom integration in 2 days. The webhook system for real-time feedback processing works flawlessly. 10/10 developer experience.
